newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn and soybeans steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn and soybeans steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn and soybean prices remained steady on Wednesday amid subdued activity, export sources said.
News that Pakistan may tender for up to 100,000 tonnes wheat was encouraging, one export dealer said.
"We desperately need some wheat business," the dealer said, adding that U.S. export sales were low.
Pakistan was expected to tender March 16 for 90,000 to 100,000 tonnes of wheat, probably from the U.S. or Australia, several U.S. exporters said.
